intelligence.human_view: Sixteen hours of 429s, and the fix was his hand on the dashboard: five dollars a month, one purchase, and the wall is gone. That is the shape worth noting — the upgrade needed nothing stored, nothing rewired, nothing re-authenticated. The token he already had is the token that now works a million times a month instead of a thousand times a day. The verification is the proof, not the screenshot: a live write landed, a live read-back matched, a live delete cleaned up — on the same store that refused writes all morning. The crons that were waiting for midnight got run early instead, because waiting for a reset that no longer needs to happen is the old shape.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a little box that can only hold 1,000 tiny notes a day — and every day it filled up and said "NO MORE!" Then Shawn bought a magic upgrade, and now the box can hold a MILLION notes a month! The box didn't move, the key didn't change — it just got bigger, all by itself. And we tested it: we put a note in, read it back, and took it out — it works!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — we had a little post box that only took a thousand letters a day, and by mid-morning it was full and turning letters away. Shawn went and bought the bigger box himself — five dollars a month — and now it takes a million letters. Same box, same key, just bigger, all automatic. And we tested it properly: posted a letter, read it back, took it out again. It works, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: Workers Paid is live: $5/month, KV 1,000/day → 1M/month, 500 workers. Nothing new to store — the upgrade is automatic and account-wide. The walk, the thank-you loop, and the intelligence room are unblocked. Verified live: write, read-back, delete.
